Tess (Design): Quick review: I'm proposing we add a small 'save layout' preference to the roles matrix in Org Settings so admins can pick Compact / Comfortable and persist it per-org. Also want to move the SSO enforcement indicator from the header into each role row for visibility when scanning. Mock: https://redwood.design/s/save-layout-mock.png :sparkles:

Arjun (Frontend): Saving a preference per-org is straightforward (backend flag + cookie fallback). Concern: moving SSO indicator into each row increases DOM size for orgs with lots of roles. We can lazy-render the pill and keep aria attributes. Also need keyboard focus on the new 'save layout' toggle.

Marta (A11y): Accessibility thoughts: 1) the save-layout control must be a native checkbox or button with aria-pressed; avoid using role="switch" unless it's keyboard operable. 2) SSO indicator in each row needs a clear accessible name, e.g., "SSO enforced for this role" or "SSO not enforced". Use aria-describedby for the explainers and ensure contrast >=4.5:1. 3) If the row contains dynamic state (server check for enforcement) announce changes with aria-live polite.

Ibrahim (PM): Product constraints: org-level SSO cannot be overridden per-role, so when enforcement is org-wide, the per-row indicator should be read-only and visually consistent (disabled state). Analytics needed: layout_pref_saved, sso_indicator_clicked, roles_matrix_view. Keep the CTA on the invite drawer as 'Invite' with microcopy under it when SSO applies: 'SSO required for new users.'

Arjun (Frontend): I'll prototype lazy DOM and ensure a11y props. Plan: .sso-pill will include aria-label and an offscreen helper for screen readers. For save-layout, use a native checkbox in a toolbar and persist via API. Will add unit tests to assert aria-live announcements fire when enforcement state resolves.

Marta (A11y): Small nit: if we use icons for SSO state include title attributes but prefer an adjacent visually-hidden text node. Also ensure tab order doesn't jump when pills appear on scroll; recommend visibility: hidden -> visible rather than remove/insert when possible.

Tess (Design): I'll update Figma to show disabled state for per-row pills and a compact vs comfortable preview. I'll shorten microcopy: 'SSO required for invited users.' and add a 'Learn more' link that opens modal (role="dialog").

Preview Bot: preview:roles-layout-save built  https://staging.redwood/preview/roles-layout-save (sha: ghi012) :white_check_mark:

Arjun (Frontend): Ran quick axe pass on preview: issues flagged: contrast on faint helper text, missing accessible name on save-layout toggle, and focus indicator missing for compact chips. I'll fix these and push PR.

Marta (A11y): Thanks. Once PR is up I'll run NVDA. If we keep these semantics and ensure live region announcements and keyboard traps for the modal, should be good. Please avoid duplicating the explanatory text both inline and in the modal for screen readers.

Ibrahim (PM): Timeline: aim for next sprint if a11y passes. If any blocking issues, hold until fixed. Thanks all. :pray:
